name: diff
title: Diff engine
description: Line diffs with histogram (default, git's most readable for code) or linear-space Myers with a cost cut, git's slider placement, hunks with context and the enclosing-definition heading, whitespace options, binary and size guards; changed words or characters within a line; a unified-diff parser for multi-file git patches (renames, copies, modes, new, deleted, binary, quoted paths); and diffTextAsync, which runs in a Web Worker past 200k characters. No dependencies.
docs: `diffText(old, new, { algorithm, context, ignoreWhitespace, maxLines, maxChars })` returns `{ status, hunks, additions, deletions }`; its output matches `git diff --histogram` (or `--minimal` with `algorithm: "myers"`). `formatHunks(hunks)` prints them back as a unified diff. `parsePatch(text)` reads `git diff`, `git show` or `diff -u` output into `FileDiff`s. `intraline(oldLine, newLine, { mode: "word" | "char" })` gives the changed ranges, or null for a rewritten line. `diffTextAsync(old, new, { signal })` diffs in a Web Worker past `workerThreshold` (200k characters), on the main thread below it, without workers, or when a Content Security Policy refuses `blob:` workers: the worker is built from the engine's own source in a Blob, so it works in every bundler without a worker file.
